name: Zerix Network
description:
Zerix Network

is a competitive MCBE PvP server, built with passion since 2018.

MCBEPVP is Zerix’s global Practice PvP network, designed for players who want responsive combat, competitive matches and a constantly evolving experience.

We are the world’s first Minecraft Bedrock PvP server to support both Java-style and Bedrock combat systems.

Connect from Europe, North America, Asia or Oceania and improve your skills through a wide selection of competitive Duels, FFA and community Events.

 WHAT WE OFFER

• Multiple duel modes

• Dual combat system: Java & Bedrock

• Next generation FFA

• Competitive tournaments and community events

• Carefully tuned combat mechanics

• Custom kits, cosmetics and progression features

• Dedicated servers across four global regions

• Continuous updates, performance improvements and bug fixes

Whether you want to practise your mechanics, challenge other players or compete in organized events, MCBEPVP provides the environment to take your gameplay further.

Server Address: mcbepvp.club

Port: 19132

Follow server development, receive important announcements and connect with the rest of the community.
